name: source-ledger
description: Source Ledger operator CLI for named team scopes, append-only journal entries, bounded ambient wake, and scoped semantic recall.

groups.name: scopes
groups.description: Register and inspect team ledger scopes

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create or verify a named team scope

flags.name: facets-json
flags.description: Facet vocabulary as a JSON array
flags.bind_waiver: facets-json is decoded by the CLI handler into Scope.facets

commands.name: list
commands.description: List registered team scopes and budgets

groups.name: policy
groups.description: Read and tune bounded context policy for one scope

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show effective policy, origin, and inherited defaults

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set one or more explicit scope policy overrides

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Delete scope overrides and restore file-default inheritance

commands.name: note
commands.description: Append a prose entry to a team scope

groups.name: recall
groups.description: Read bounded or semantic team context

commands.name: wake
commands.description: Render bounded ambient context for one team scope
